dataset.label_definition: REAL is an unaltered procedural scene paired with its matching caption; FAKE is its paired version with one caption or image attribute altered to contradict the other modality. These labels do not assert real-world news truth.
limitations: Controlled synthetic benchmark; no accuracy claim on real-world news or photos.
Matching captions and procedural source scenes define REAL.
Explicit attribute extraction makes this task much easier than general multimodal misinformation.
Labels, paths, ids, manipulation names, source and split are never input features.

experiments.name: Text-only baseline
experiments.description: Train-only unigram/bigram TF-IDF followed by L2 logistic regression.

experiments.name: Image-only baseline
experiments.description: Pixel-derived color, shape, count, foreground fraction, fill and RGB features followed by L2 logistic regression.

experiments.name: Feature-level fusion
experiments.description: Concatenated TF-IDF, image attributes and explicit cross-modal contradiction features followed by L2 logistic regression.

experiments.name: Decision-level fusion
experiments.description: Independent text/image probabilities blended with a weight selected by validation log loss.

experiments.name: Modality ablation
experiments.description: Fixed trained fusion model; missing feature families replaced by training means. This is an inference ablation, not retraining.

variants.name: Without Text
variants.description: Replace text and cross-modal features with their training means.

variants.name: Without Image
variants.description: Replace image and cross-modal features with their training means.

variants.name: Without Cross Modal
variants.description: Replace only joint contradiction features with their training means.

experiments.name: Held-out manipulation
experiments.description: Count alterations never occur among train/validation/test negatives. OOD has entirely new scene groups and matching REAL controls. This is manipulation OOD within synthetic shapes, not real-photo OOD.

faithfulness.protocol: On the first 48 fixed test records, delete each distinct caption token and recompute predictions; compare attribute-token effects with filler-token effects. Correct false captions and introduce a color conflict into matching captions. These measure local perturbation sensitivity, not causal truth or human explanation quality.
faithfulness.image_region_method: Each detected object rectangle is painted with the light background and rescored. Signed deltas are returned; occlusion can move an example off the training distribution.
faithfulness.cross_modal_method: Hold encoders fixed and counterfactually flip one attribute comparison; impact equals original minus changed FAKE probability. Baseline cross-modal impacts are zero.

notes: FAKE is positive class; confusion matrices have true rows and predicted columns in order REAL, FAKE.
PR-AUC is average precision (step integration) with tied scores grouped.
Reported test metrics force a binary label at 0.5; interactive demo additionally abstains outside its domain or below 0.58 confidence.
difficult_case_selection: The 8 smallest-margin test pairs from each class (16 total), selected after all model fitting. These are relative low-confidence cases, not necessarily errors.
